name: Temporary Accommodation Assistance
description: Temporary Accommodation Assistance provides financial support to homeowners whose homes have been affected by a natural disaster or weather event, leaving them with temporary accommodation costs.

attributes.summary: A financial assistance product for homeowners displaced from their homes due to damage (yellow/red placard), covering temporary accommodation costs with provisions for eligibility, payments, changes in circumstances, and interactions with other MSD and non-MSD assistance.
attributes.eligibility: Residence requirement, homeowner of affected home, yellow or red placard for affected home, unavoidable homeownership costs, had temporary accommodation costs
attributes.payment_details: Temporary Accommodation Assistance lump sum payments, discretionary grant
attributes.obligations: No longer had temporary accommodation costs, no longer owned the affected home, no longer had costs for their affected home, reoccupied the affected home, expiry of programme
